BiblicalUsage: Harhaiah is named once, as a goldsmith and the father of Uzziel, who repaired the wall of Jerusalem beside the apothecaries. His son worked the wall next to Hananiah of the apothecaries, and they fortified it to the broad wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the goldsmith's son rebuilding a wall is the whole return from exile in miniature: every trade took up the work.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
